decisions.reason: The maintenance oil line complements the firm's oiled-floor surface treatments at low holding cost, and dropping the cleaning soap already pruned the care range, so this option remains worth keeping.
The care line for oiled floors costs little to keep listed, but it may overlap with the maintenance oil after the soap's withdrawal, so a modest risk of consolidation remains.
A moisture-protection underlay is a functional accessory that installers and trade buyers need with floating floors, so keeping this cheap option preserves complementary sales.
The high-density foam underlay is the most likely to overlap with other underlays, but two years of low carrying cost and still-uncertain demand do not yet justify abandoning it.
The oak parquet line is core to the firm's flooring business, so the firm is far more likely to commit further than to abandon it.
